 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Minnesota Vikings head on the road to challenge the Green Bay Packers in a rematch of their Week 1 opener. The team is facing a Packers team that is finding its footing in recent weeks, and quarterback Jordan Love is looking like an MVP candidate.
 Both teams are dealing with a handful of injuries that could swing the matchup in one team's favor or the other. In this piece, we are discussing the status of T.J. Hockenson.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Is T.J. Hockenson playing in Week 10?
 Hockenson did not practice all week due to rib and wrist issues. He was ruled out early on in the week and has since missed out on the biggest weekend the Vikings' offense has had in some time. The arrival of Kirk Cousins will be even better for everyone once he gets his favorite tight end target back.
